tabs.html:
TP-Link Deco X10 AX1500 Dual-Band Mesh Wi-Fi 6 Router

Upgrade your home or office internet with the TP-Link Deco X10 AX1500 Dual-Band Mesh Wi-Fi 6 Router (1 Pack) – built to deliver faster speeds, wider coverage, and stable connections for every device. Powered by Wi-Fi 6 technology, the Deco X10 reaches speeds up to 1201 Mbps on 5 GHz and 300 Mbps on 2.4 GHz, ensuring smooth 4K streaming, ultra-low latency gaming, and lightning-fast downloads even when multiple devices are connected.

With advanced MU-MIMO and OFDMA technology, this router handles dozens of devices at once without buffering. Its Mesh system ensures seamless roaming across your home, so you stay connected without drops. Designed for Bangladesh’s modern internet needs, it’s perfect for work-from-home setups, online classes, and entertainment streaming. The easy-to-use Deco App makes setup simple, and WPA3 encryption keeps your network secure.


Key Specifications:

  • Model: TP-Link Deco X10
  • Wi-Fi Standard: Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax)
  • Speed: AX1500 (5 GHz: 1201 Mbps + 2.4 GHz: 300 Mbps)
  • Coverage: Up to 1,500 sq. ft. per unit
  • Frequency: Dual-Band (2.4 GHz & 5 GHz)
  • Wi-Fi 6 Features: MU-MIMO, OFDMA, Beamforming for faster and more efficient connections
  • Processor: 1.0 GHz Dual-Core
  • Ethernet Ports: 2 × Gigabit WAN/LAN Ports
  • Security: WPA3 encryption, TP-Link HomeShield
  • Mesh Technology: Seamless roaming between Deco units
  • Control: TP-Link Deco App (iOS & Android)
  • Voice Control: Works with Amazon Alexa
  • Warranty: 1 Year (Bangladesh)
